scholarships.title: University of Oulu Early Bird Discount and Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship

existing.description: The University of Oulu does not give scholarships to first-year students. Instead, selected degree programmes offer an Early Bird Discount of 5% to 30% on the first-year tuition if the fee is paid within three weeks of the admission results being published. Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarships of 5% to 40% are available from the second year onwards, awarded to continuing students who complete at least 60 ECTS credits in the preceding academic year in line with their study plan. The university states it does not offer any scholarship covering 100% of tuition fees.
eligibility: Admitted to an English-taught Bachelor's or Master's programme at the University of Oulu
Not a citizen of an EU/EEA country or Switzerland, and no residence permit exempting tuition
For the Early Bird Discount: pay the tuition fee within three weeks of the admission results being published
For the Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship: complete at least 60 ECTS credits in the preceding academic year in line with the approved study plan, including the required Finnish language studies
existing.eligibility_summary: Students admitted to English-taught Bachelor's and Master's degree programmes at the University of Oulu who are not citizens of EU/EEA countries or Switzerland and do not hold a residence permit exempting them from tuition fees. Award and percentage vary by degree programme.
